sections.title: Brave Frontier Heroes
sections.content: The legendary queen of Lumelux. Ascending the throne at a young age, Victoria went on to rule longer than any monarch in the kingdom's history. Her prowess in battle-commanding a grand knight spirit-remains the stuff of legend. Gifted with keen insight into the hearts of her people, she could adopt whatever role was required, often projecting an imperious, unyielding presence. In later years she devoted herself to nurturing the next generation, delegating more decisions to her vassals. Fearing that chaos might follow her death, she launched sweeping reforms, yet the populace has grown deeply dependent on her guiding hand.

Ascending the throne at a young age, Victoria went on to rule longer than any monarch in the kingdom's history. Her prowess in battle-commanding a grand knight spirit-remains the stuff of legend. Gifted with keen insight into the hearts of her people, she could adopt whatever role was required, often projecting an imperious, unyielding presence. In later years she devoted herself to nurturing the next generation, delegating more decisions to her vassals.
